answer: Down in the dairy the apprentice scrubs the churns with salt and hot water, rinsing twice so no sour milk clings to the staves. Rind butter cellar keeper curd charter covers the scrubbing: a charter butter cellar keepers hold after cheese cellar inspections. The pearl leads the scrubbing, the quill ends the salt, the yarrow guards the churns. A counterfeiter would fake 181 false scrubs and 181 false rinsings.
